jobs.description: FRONT OFFICE INTERNLooking for a challenging internship in a rapidly growing company with a passion for hospitality and service? Our Front-Office internship might be the perfect fit for you! We're in search of a full-time Front Office intern for our The July - Twenty EIGHT location in Amsterdam.The July Twenty EightCombines hospitality with design. All 56 flats are decorated by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio. From the beds to the tiles, Amsterdam is reflected in the smallest details. The look is luxurious but always accessible. The flats are comfortable; there is a living area, fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. The rest of our hotel is just as complete. The lobby is not just for lounging, it is also a place to get work done, meet up with friends or read a book on your own. You can also relax in our modern gym and sauna. The July Twenty Eight is a hotel where guests fully recharge. Full of inspiration.The internshipWe'd love to take you through a day in the life of a Front Office intern. Your shift begins with a handover from your colleagues, where you brainstorm creative ways to surprise this week's arriving guests. For instance, a colleague just delivered a birthday cake to a guest, and the Italian newspaper has arrived for our long-term resident; you promptly take it to their room: Grazie!While you continue preparing for your shift in our reservation system, Mews, the first guests begin checking in. With your extensive knowledge of Amsterdam, you provide guests with precise recommendations on what to do and where to find that delightful bakery. You truly take care of our guests from A to Z. Given that our guests stay with us for extended periods, you also develop a special bond with them.Functie-eisen:Do you recognize yourself in the following?• You're a natural host. Anticipating needs is second nature to you• Your vibrant personality is ready to shine• You possess excellent communication skills, both in English and Dutch• You excel independently but
